_readme: The registry of CLAIMS this repository has WITHDRAWN, and the spellings that must not reappear. WFG-062. One entry per withdrawn claim: what was withdrawn, the artifact or escalation that withdrew it, the pragma tokens that license a deliberate mention, and the banned spellings. scripts/check_withdrawn_claims.py checks EVERY tracked .md and .html against every entry; tests/test_withdrawn_claims_registry.py is the gate. Adding a claim here gates it across the whole tree at once: that is the point of the file. See docs/withdrawn_claims.md for what it does and does NOT do.

scope._readme: The default is EVERY tracked .md and .html file. `record_prefixes` is the one exception class and every member carries a reason: these are the files whose job is to QUOTE a withdrawn claim in order to record that it was withdrawn. No judge reads them. A path may not be both a record path and a member of a hand-rolled guard list in tests/test_detection_ordering_is_not_claimed.py; the gate refuses that.

claims.claim: docs/oracle_gap.md §4 said 「Across the artifact the ratios are 0.74 / 1.02 / 1.05 / 1.05: at 3 h the simulation is 26 % under, not within 2 %」 and read that as a property of the forecast across the horizon.
